gloss_en: the letter-pair Lamed–Yud that spells the word לִי ("for Me") in "מִי יָקוּם לִי עִם מְרֵעִים", expounded as the joining of the letter Lamed (alluding to Upper Wisdom, chokhmah ila'ah) with the letter Yod (alluding to Lower Wisdom, chokhmah tata'ah) — the union effected by the true tzaddik; not the verb לָמַד ("he learned")
